goal: Expose bounded per-connection remote disconnect notifications required by the ECS server lifecycle without changing the core transport contract.
acceptance: UnityTransportServerHost.TryDequeueDisconnected(out ConnectionId) returns the exact endpoint removed by a remote UTP Disconnect event
Each observed remote disconnect is returned once in FIFO observation order
Pending disconnect storage is bounded by MaximumConnections and overflow increments existing drop diagnostics
Local endpoint disposal does not synthesize a second remote disconnect notification
Focused loopback tests cover identity, single delivery, multiple endpoints and bounded overflow behavior
Existing adapter tests and public API documentation remain valid
